1/ Health Concerns
🚨 Detection of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases in Karnataka and Gujarat is raising alarm.
HMPV is similar to COVID-19 and can lead to respiratory issues, sparking fears of economic disruption.

2/ Weak Asian Markets
🇨🇳 Broader Asian markets are in the red due to worries over US policy shifts that could affect global trade.
This has triggered sell-offs across emerging markets, including India.

nodes.author: Navigate_In
nodes.text:
3/ Heavyweight Stock Declines
📉 Major players like Tata Steel, Reliance, and HDFC Bank saw sharp falls, dragging the indices down.
Reliance alone contributed significantly to today's dip.

nodes.author: Navigate_In
nodes.text:
4/ FII Selling Pressure
💸 Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) are pulling out funds, adding downward pressure on the market.
Persistent FII selling often leads to volatility and uncertainty.

nodes.text:
5/ Result:
📊 Sensex - Down 1,200+ points
📊 Nifty 50 - Falls by 1.6%
A mix of global, health, and institutional factors is driving today's market slump.
